violation_type.title: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism (26 TAC §747.3303(c)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism
violation_type.typical_finding: The caregiver is using a shelf accessible to children for diaper changing. There are no observed safety mechanisms in place such as raised sides.

finding_variants.text: The caregiver is using a shelf accessible to children for diaper changing. There are no observed safety mechanisms in place such as raised sides.
Students were observed being changed on a table without raised sides.
